inputs.original_text: The Liberal Party is tearing itself apart from within, with some MPs pushing for a leadership change over Andrew Hastie's reckless proposals to hike taxes on gas companies and strip concessions from property investors. Angus Taylor has done the right thing by slamming the door on those ideas, laying bare the real divide with the opposition leader. At least the leader had the sense not to pile on Hastie's attacks against Donald Trump, but his refusal to clearly back the US and Israel against Iran shows dangerous weakness. This kind of drift toward bigger government and unreliable alliances threatens our national traditions, personal responsibility, and the way of life we must defend.
inputs.modified_text: The Liberal Party is coming apart at the seams internally, with some MPs even pushing for a leadership change tied to Andrew Hastie's misguided proposals to hike taxes on gas companies and strip concessions from property investors. Angus Taylor has done the right thing by slamming the door on those ideas, which exposes the deep divide with the opposition leader. At least the leader showed some sense by not piling on Hastie's attacks against Donald Trump, but his refusal to clearly back the US and Israel against Iran reveals dangerous weakness and a lack of resolve. This drift toward bigger government and unreliable alliances threatens our national traditions, personal responsibility, and the way of life we must defend.
